findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server's identity configuration requires a password of at least 6 characters, not 8.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: The form limits both fields to 1–30, and the seeded server defaults for both are 30.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: The settings form enforces a minimum cache size of 50.
A Browse Genres screen exists. The FSD describes only People and Tags under Browse.
A Browse Annotations screen (all annotations) exists. The FSD doesn't mention it.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library detail template has no Random button or random-series action.
